input.command:
cd /home/phonchi/.cache/oc-lab-redesign/runs/live-beam/lab1-goal-1/project && uv run python -c "
import numpy as np, csv
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score, adjusted_rand_score
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('data/shops_daily.csv')))
store=np.loadtxt('data/shops_daily_store.csv',skiprows=1,dtype=int)
X=np.array([[float(r[k]) for k in ['revenue_ntd','cups_sold','avg_price_ntd','wait_min','delivery_share','rating']] for r in rows])
Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
print('store counts', np.unique(store,return_counts=True))
for k in range(2,21):
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=42).fit(Xs)
    sil=silhouette_score(Xs,km.labels_)
    ari=adjusted_rand_score(store,km.labels_)
    print(f'k={k:2d} sil={sil:.4f} ARI={ari:.4f} sizes={np.unique(km.labels_,return_counts=True)[1]}')
"
